{{Short description|Concept in mathematics}}
{{Uniform hyperbolic tiles db|Uniform hyperbolic tiling stat table|Ui3_01}}
In [[geometry]], the '''truncated order-3 apeirogonal tiling''' is a [[uniform tilings in hyperbolic plane|uniform tiling]] of the [[hyperbolic geometry|hyperbolic plane]] with a [[Schläfli symbol]] of t{∞,3}.

== Dual tiling==
The dual tiling, the '''infinite-order triakis triangular tiling''', has [[face configuration]] V3.∞.∞.
:[[File:Ord-infin triakis triang til.png|240px]]

== Related polyhedra and tiling ==

This hyperbolic tiling is topologically related as a part of sequence of uniform [[truncation (geometry)|truncated]] polyhedra with [[vertex configuration]]s (3.2n.2n), and [n,3] [[Coxeter group]] symmetry.
